title: runtime: the organization-ownership boot refusals prescribe `--out PLAN` / `--apply --plan-file PLAN`, which 18.0 refuses on every database (#24637, domain:cli row)
body:
Filing gate **④**: a per-lane child of the coordination parent #24637 (18.0 release text family). Each row is ①'s release-text exception. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat, in one PR on the file below.

## Row

In 18.0, `os migrate organization-ownership` refuses plan and apply on every database (`ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). The runtime's boot refusals still send the operator there. On `origin/main` `f89d29e382`, `packages/runtime/src/organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts` says:
- `:242`: "…then run '${ceremony} --out PLAN' again, review it, run '${ceremony} --apply --plan-file PLAN …";
- `:256–257`: "Run '${ceremony} --out PLAN' to write and review its plan, take a backup, then run '${ceremony} --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken', and start again.";
- `:342–343`: "…or run the ceremony ('${ceremony} --out PLAN', then '${ceremony} --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken'), then start again."

**Done:** each branch says what 18.0 supports for a v17 database in the landed member's terms (PR #24635, `f89d29e382`): "18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path." Pin the message text. This is text only: the refusal codes and the boot outcome do not move.

## Dedupe

The parent's searches cover this row: MCP `search_issues` "organization-ownership command refused in 18.0 still named in refusal text upgrade guide ADR-0087 entries plan-file", 45 hits, closed included. The family members are #24566, #24567 and #23871, all closed. #23871 is the earlier boot-refusal wording, and it predates 18.0's refusal. None covers these branches.
